This suggests that while the proportion of immigrant workers in the labor market may decrease, the absolute number of immigrant workers may increase with greater ease of immigration. The negative relationship with `share_immi_imputed` is statistically significant (coefficient = -0.00277, p-value = 0.0002), while the positive relationship with `empl_immi_imputed` is also statistically significant (coefficient = 8016.0063, p-value = 0.0016).
